name: INSACERMO_NASA_CMAPSS_FD001_RETRIEVAL_COMPATIBILITY_NOTE_V1
failure_detail: The GitHub-hosted runner timed out while connecting to the official NASA CMAPSSData.zip URL before any dataset bytes were read and before any scientific endpoint was computed.

retrieval_fix.method: Use a pinned public GitHub mirror of the C-MAPSS FD001 text files instead of the NASA redirecting ZIP endpoint.
retrieval_fix.selection_reason: The mirror exposes the exact standard C-MAPSS filenames and is pinned to a fixed commit. It was selected solely to replace the failed transport path, not based on RUL values or scientific results.
retrieval_fix.integrity_policy: Record SHA256 hashes of both downloaded text files in the audit artifact and assert the preregistered 100-engine shape before analysis.
